LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableTouchModeDesc: Enables RimTouch direct touch gestures and UI tap repair.
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableGlobeTwistDesc: Turn two fingers to roll the world view. A deliberate twist releases the world's north-up lock. Use North-up in the world view to straighten it again.
LanguageData.RimTouch.TwistCommitDegreesDesc: How far two fingers must twist (in degrees) before the globe starts rotating. Higher values make accidental rotation during pinch-zoom or drag much less likely; once a gesture is clearly a pinch or a drag, rotation is locked out for that gesture.
LanguageData.RimTouch.LockNorthUpOnDragDesc: Drag the globe with a two-axis turntable: horizontal drags spin around the north pole, vertical drags pitch around the screen's horizontal axis. The drag itself never rolls, so north keeps the heading it had when the drag started. Turn off for the free globe-spinning drag (the grabbed point follows the finger, roll included).
LanguageData.RimTouch.TurntableDragSensitivityDesc: How fast the globe turns when you drag with one finger (dual-axis mode only). 1.00x is the default; lower values make dragging slower and more precise, higher values make it faster. Only applies while 'Dual-axis mode' is on.
LanguageData.RimTouch.InvertTurntableAxisDesc: Flip the turntable drag direction: dragging right rotates the globe left, dragging up rotates it down. Off by default (dragging follows your finger). Turn on only if you prefer the old inverted direction.
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableWorldPointDrag: Point-and-drag to multi-select on the globe
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableWorldPointDragDesc: Double-tap, hold, then drag on the globe to draw a selection box and select every faction and settlement inside it, like dragging with a mouse. The box is drawn with an animated marching-ants border. Turn off to keep double-tap-hold-drag panning the globe instead.
LanguageData.RimTouch.AllowExtraUiScalesDesc: Opt in to scales outside the game's normal resolution checks. Turn this off to restore the native scale choices.
LanguageData.RimTouch.ExtraScalesUnavailable: Extra scales are unavailable on this game build; native scale limits apply.
LanguageData.RimTouch.ExtendedZoomRangeNote: Extended zoom range. Disabling restores prior bounds if this mod still owns them.
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableExtendedZoomRangeDesc: Lets you zoom in closer and out further than vanilla allows.
